posts.subject: Beschwerde gegen Bretzel
posts.bodyHtml:
Moin,


ich habe eben eine Weile auf dem SurfDM gespielt als ich festgestellt habe, dass sich Bretzel ("[=ST=]Bretzel[FR]" STEAM_1:0:47039587 ) die ganze Zeit im Secret auf Utopia aufhält. Habe auch Demo gemacht (Ist im ts im dafür vorgesehenen Ordner).


Hat vor und nach der Demo noch weiter gecampt aber selbst diese sollte lang genug sein.
@Fiddles @Ploiken @Nachtfrische

I have the right to anwser and defend myself.


I stayed a long time in secret because of a team, therealfdp (a french team) . One of their member was using a wallhack. He hit me 5 time in a frow with awp. 3 time in the back secret then i moved to side secret and then i recieved almost immediatly one hit in chest then one hit in head. So i stayed as long as i could in secret to try to catch this again on demo.
But i told him i suspected a cheat so on the demo there is nothing realy obvious.

@Bretzel


You still need to comply with the rules, that's why we have staff to uphold them. It's like real law in a sense. In most countries, if you were to break the law in order to find incriminating evidence of another person; you would still be punished for your actions. And I feel this to be statutory for this sort of situation. Please wait out your ban and join back again (if it hasn't timed out yet). I hope this does not come of inconvenience to you, and thank you for trying at the least for getting the demo, even though it was rather fraught with undelegated actions that went against the rules.
